rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterising whether braking is needed and whether the maneuver is initiated and performed. SG-1, FR-7, and H-1 establish braking behavior itself as the phenomenon, while FR-7.1 explicitly supports including braking initiation. The scope remains within collision-avoidance braking and does not incorporate supporting sensing, computation, communication, or failure-management mechanisms.
determining_elements: “Whether braking is required … or omitted” directly addresses the evaluation target and SG-1.
“Started, performed” characterises the braking behavior required by FR-7 and FR-7.1, rather than merely supporting control mechanisms.
The obstacle-avoidance scope is supported by FR-7 and H-1, including road users and static obstacles; it is not limited to the single pedestrian scenario.
P does not import obstacle-detection latency, sensor-fusion behavior, or controller internals into the phenomenon.
